+# ===================
+#  Author: Peize Lin
+#  date: 2023.08.17
+# ===================
+
+import textwrap
+import numpy as np
+
+class judge_fix_Error(Exception):
+	def __init__(self, error):
+		Exception.__init__(self, error)
+
+def generate_cal(Txy, Tx, Ty, file):
+	def judge_fix(T, sub):
+		size = len(sub)
+		if T[:size] == sub:
+			return "prefix",T[size:]
+		elif T[-size:] == sub:
+			return "suffix", T[:-size]
+		else:
+			raise judge_fix_Error(f"T={T}, sub={sub}")
+
+	contraction = sorted(list(set(Tx + Ty) - set(Txy)))
+	fix_x, remain_x = judge_fix(Tx, contraction)
+	fix_y, remain_y = judge_fix(Ty, contraction)
+	fix_xy, remain_xy = judge_fix(Txy, remain_x)
+	assert(fix_xy=="prefix")
+	assert(remain_xy == remain_y)
+
+	def get_index(T, fix, remain):
+		if fix=="prefix":
+			return np.arange(0,len(T),1)[-len(remain):]
+		elif fix=="suffix":
+			return np.arange(0,len(T),1)[:len(remain)]
+	xr = get_index(Tx, fix_x, remain_x)
+	yr = get_index(Ty, fix_y, remain_y)
+	if fix_x=="prefix":
+		con_x = np.arange(0,len(Tx),1)[:len(contraction)]
+	elif fix_x=="suffix":
+		con_x = np.arange(0,len(Tx),1)[-len(contraction):]
+
+	indentation = 1
+	content = textwrap.indent(textwrap.dedent(f"""\
+		// Txy({",".join(Txy)}) = Tx({",".join(Tx)}) * Ty({",".join(Ty)})
+		template<typename Tdata>
+		Tensor<Tdata> {"".join(Txy)}_{"".join(Tx)}_{"".join(Ty)}(const Tensor<Tdata> &Tx, const Tensor<Tdata> &Ty)
+		{{
+			assert(Tx.shape.size()=={len(Tx)});
+			assert(Ty.shape.size()=={len(Ty)});
+		"""),
+		"\t"*indentation)
+	content += textwrap.indent(textwrap.dedent(f"""\
+			Tensor<Tdata> Txy({{{", ".join([f"T{s[0]}.shape[{s[1]}]" for s in Txy])}}});
+			Blas_Interface::gemm(
+				{"'T'" if fix_x=="prefix" else "'N'"}, {"'N'" if fix_y=="prefix" else "'T'"},
+				{" * ".join([f"Tx.shape[{i}]" for i in xr])},
+				{" * ".join([f"Ty.shape[{i}]" for i in yr])},
+				{" * ".join([f"Tx.shape[{i}]" for i in con_x])},
+				Tdata(1.0), Tx.ptr(), Ty.ptr(),
+				Tdata(0.0), Txy.ptr());
+			return Txy;
+		}}
+		"""),
+		"\t"*indentation)
+
+	file.write(content)

+
+import textwrap
+
+def generate_test(Txy, Tx, Ty, file):
+	indentation = 1
+	contraction = sorted(list(set(Tx + Ty) - set(Txy)))
+	content = textwrap.indent(textwrap.dedent(f"""\
+		// Txy({",".join(Txy)}) = Tx({",".join(Tx)}) * Ty({",".join(Ty)})
+		template<typename Tdata>
+		void {"".join(Txy)}_{"".join(Tx)}_{"".join(Ty)}_test()
+		{{
+			std::cout<<"Txy({','.join(Txy)}) = Tx({','.join(Tx)}) * Ty({','.join(Ty)})"<<std::endl;
+			const std::size_t """),
+		"\t"*indentation)
+	content += ", ".join([f"{s.upper()}={i+2}" for i,s in enumerate(Txy + contraction)]) + ";\n"
+	content += textwrap.indent(textwrap.dedent(f"""\
+			const RI::Tensor<Tdata> Tx = init_tensor<Tdata>({{{",".join([s.upper() for s in Tx])}}});
+			const RI::Tensor<Tdata> Ty = init_tensor<Tdata>({{{",".join([s.upper() for s in Ty])}}});
+			const RI::Tensor<Tdata> Txy = RI::Tensor_Multiply::{"".join(Txy)}_{"".join(Tx)}_{"".join(Ty)}(Tx,Ty);
+		"""),
+		"\t"*(indentation+1))
+	for i,index in enumerate(Txy):
+		content += "\t"*(indentation+1+i) + f"FOR_0({index},{index.upper()})\n"
+	content += textwrap.indent(textwrap.dedent(f"""\
+		{{
+			Tdata result = 0;
+		"""),
+		"\t"*(indentation+1+i))
+	for j,index in enumerate(contraction):
+		content += "\t"*(indentation+2+i+j) + f"FOR_0({index},{index.upper()})\n"
+	content += "\t"*(indentation+3+i+j) + f'result += Tx({",".join(Tx)}) * Ty({",".join(Ty)});\n'
+	content += "\t"*(indentation+2+i) + f'assert(Txy({",".join(Txy)}) == result);\n'
+	content += "\t"*(indentation+1+i) + "}\n"
+	content += "\t"*(indentation) + "}\n"
+
+	file.write(content)

+# ===================
+#  Author: Peize Lin
+#  date: 2023.08.17
+# ===================
+
+import Tensor_Multiply
+import Tensor_Multiply_UnitTest
+import textwrap
+
+def generate_cal(T_list, file_name):
+	with open(file_name, "w") as file:
+		file.write(textwrap.dedent("""\
+			// ===================
+			//  Author: Peize Lin
+			//  date: 2023.08.03
+			// ===================
+
+			#pragma once
+
+			#include "Tensor_Multiply.h"
+
+			namespace RI
+			{
+
+			namespace Tensor_Multiply
+			{
+			"""))
+
+		for Txy, Tx, Ty in T_list:
+			Tensor_Multiply.generate_cal(Txy, Tx, Ty, file)
+			print("", file=file)
+
+		file.write(textwrap.dedent("""\
+			}
+
+			}
+			"""))
+
+
+
+def generate_test(T_list, file_name):
+	with open(file_name, "w") as file:
+		file.write(textwrap.dedent("""\
+			// ===================
+			//  Author: Peize Lin
+			//  date: 2023.08.03
+			// ===================
+
+			#pragma once
+
+			#include "Tensor_Multiply-test.hpp"
+
+			#define FOR_0(i,N)	\
+				for(std::size_t i=0; i<N; ++i)
+
+			namespace Tensor_Multiply_Test
+			{
+			"""))
+
+		for Txy, Tx, Ty in T_list:
+			Tensor_Multiply_UnitTest.generate_test(Txy, Tx, Ty, file)
+			print("", file=file)
+
+		file.write(textwrap.dedent("""\
+			}
+
+			#undef FOR_0
+			"""))
+
+
+
+
+
+def generate_test_head(T_list, file_name):
+	with open(file_name,"w") as file:
+		file.write(textwrap.dedent("""\
+			// ===================
+			//  Author: Peize Lin
+			//  date: 2023.08.03
+			// ===================
+
+			#pragma once
+
+			#include "RI/global/Tensor_Multiply.h"
+
+			namespace Tensor_Multiply_Test
+			{
+				template<typename Tdata>
+				RI::Tensor<Tdata> init_tensor(const RI::Shape_Vector &shape)
+				{
+					RI::Tensor<Tdata> T(shape);
+					const std::size_t size = T.shape.get_shape_all();
+					for(std::size_t i=0; i<size; ++i)
+						T.ptr()[i] = i;
+					return T;
+				}
+			}
+
+			#include "Tensor_Multiply-22-test.hpp"
+			#include "Tensor_Multiply-23-test.hpp"
+			#include "Tensor_Multiply-32-test.hpp"
+			#include "Tensor_Multiply-33-test.hpp"
+
+			namespace Tensor_Multiply_Test
+			{
+				template<typename Tdata>
+				void main()
+				{
+			"""))
+
+		for Txy, Tx, Ty in T_list:
+			file.write(textwrap.indent(textwrap.dedent(f"""\
+				{"".join(Txy)}_{"".join(Tx)}_{"".join(Ty)}_test<Tdata>();
+				"""), "\t"*2))
+
+		file.write(textwrap.dedent("""\
+				}
+			}
+			"""))
+
+
+T_list_all = {
+	"22": [
+			[["x0","y0"], ["x0","a"], ["y0","a"]],
+			[["x0","y1"], ["x0","a"], ["a","y1"]],
+			[["x1","y0"], ["a","x1"], ["y0","a"]],
+			[["x1","y1"], ["a","x1"], ["a","y1"]],
+		],
+	"23": [
+			[["x0","y0","y1"], ["x0","a"], ["y0","y1","a"]],
+			[["x0","y1","y2"], ["x0","a"], ["a","y1","y2"]],
+			[["x1","y0","y1"], ["a","x1"], ["y0","y1","a"]],
+			[["x1","y1","y2"], ["a","x1"], ["a","y1","y2"]],
+		],
+	"32": [
+			[["x0","x1","y0"], ["x0","x1","a"], ["y0","a"]],
+			[["x0","x1","y1"], ["x0","x1","a"], ["a","y1"]],
+			[["x1","x2","y0"], ["a","x1","x2"], ["y0","a"]],
+			[["x1","x2","y1"], ["a","x1","x2"], ["a","y1"]],
+		],
+	"33": [
+			[["x0","y0"], ["x0","a","b"], ["y0","a","b"]],
+			[["x0","y2"], ["x0","a","b"], ["a","b","y2"]],
+			[["x2","y0"], ["a","b","x2"], ["y0","a","b"]],
+			[["x2","y2"], ["a","b","x2"], ["a","b","y2"]],
+			[["x0","x1","y0","y1"], ["x0","x1","a"], ["y0","y1","a"]],
+			[["x0","x1","y1","y2"], ["x0","x1","a"], ["a","y1","y2"]],
+			[["x1","x2","y0","y1"], ["a","x1","x2"], ["y0","y1","a"]],
+			[["x1","x2","y1","y2"], ["a","x1","x2"], ["a","y1","y2"]],
+		  ],
+}
+
+for label,T_list in T_list_all.items():
+	generate_cal(T_list, f"../../include/RI/global/Tensor_Multiply-{label}.hpp")
+	generate_test(T_list, f"../../unittests/global/Tensor_Multiply-{label}-test.hpp")
+generate_test_head(sum(T_list_all.values(),[]), "../../unittests/global/Tensor_Multiply-test.hpp")
